caseDescription: Equivalent scenario to locale-en-notification.json: a WhatsApp-generated attachment placeholder string rendered in an Indonesian device/app UI locale.
notes: Pairs with locale-en-notification.json using the same shortcutId/conversationTitle to represent literally the same chat scenario. Any locale-specific phrase matching in the legacy fallback tier must recognize both variants and must remain a secondary signal only, per ADR-003, never the primary classifier.
